summary.name: Claude
summary.one_liner: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, offered as a chat-based thinking partner with free, Pro, and Max subscription tiers.
use_cases: Chatting with an AI assistant on web, desktop, or mobile
Searching the web and creating files with AI
Running code and coding help with Claude Code
Generating finished docs, slides, sheets, or designs
Working with Claude inside Chrome or Microsoft 365
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Claude as an AI assistant from Anthropic for chat on web, desktop, and mobile. The free tier includes web search, file creation, code execution, memory across conversations, and connections to apps and tools. Pro adds higher usage limits, the ability to hand off tasks and get back finished documents, slides, sheets, and designs, Claude Code, Claude Science, Projects, more models, and Claude in Chrome and Microsoft 365. Max offers 5x or 20x more usage than Pro, higher output limits, early access to advanced features, and priority access at high traffic times.
notable: Free tier with web search, file creation, code running, and cross-conversation memory
Claude Code and Claude in Chrome access on paid plans
Max plan offers 5x or 20x Pro usage limits
caveats: Usage limits apply to all plans
Prices exclude applicable tax and are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion
Max plan starts at $100 per month
